name: Query references column that no longer exists
modeled_on: A migration renamed a column (`email_addr` -> `email`) but one query was never updated, so every lookup raises `no such column`. Real-world analogue: SQLAlchemy/Django apps after an ALTER TABLE rename where a raw SQL statement or stale ORM field was missed. The fix must read the actual schema to find the real column.
ground_truth: Reference the column that actually exists in the schema (`email`, not `email_addr`).
